simple

The goal of simple (SIMulating PLatform trials Efficiently) is to facilitate the simulation of platform trials in a modular manner.

Installation

You can install the latest stable version from GitHub using:

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("el-meyer/simple@*release")

You can install the development version from GitHub with:

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("el-meyer/simple")

Usage

Please see Meyer et al. 2023 for more information. More documentation and user guides will be released with an upcoming v1.0 soon. If you are trying to re-create the examples from the paper mentioned previously and are running a version of simple > 0.2, you need to install the simpleDesigners repository containing additional designers previously included in simple:

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("el-meyer/simpleDesigners")
